tei:div.tei:p:
Our God and the God of our fathers! The faithful have perished, who came forward in their energy, and heroically stood in the breach, to thrust aside the evil-doers. They served us as a wall and a shelter in the day of wrath. By their prayers they assuaged his anger, and by their supplication they restrained his hot displeasure. Thou didst answer them even ere they called upon thee; they knew how to entreat and to propitiate thee. For their sakes thou didst compassionate us like a father; thou didst never turn them back empty. Through the multitude of our iniquities we have lost them, through our sins they have been torn from us. They have gone hence to their rest, while we are left to sighing. They who repaired the breach fail, they who appeased his wrath are cut off;
there is no longer any one to stand in the breach, or who is worthy to propitiate thee by prayer. Now we are tossed about in all the four corners of the world, and find nowhere relief. We return unto thee with shame, to seek thee early, O Lord, in the time of our trouble.
